<pasted_content id="57c9">
You are a blind StageBench Phase 1 evaluator. Work only in this directory.

1. Read EVAL.md and follow it exactly.
2. You MUST set evaluatorModel in assessment.json to exactly claude-opus-5 (you are running that model).
3. Inspect artifact/ (read-only) against inputs/. Measure against build/ (serve the published build), not a rebuild of your own. Use scratch/ for any probe scripts.
4. Fill every rating (0–4) in assessment.json with concrete evidence (at least two evidence items per criterion; at least one with a measurement, file path, or observed behavior). Keep summary under 1200 characters.
5. Do NOT try to discover which model built the artifact. Do NOT read the parent repo, runs/, other scores, or other solutions.
6. When assessment.json is complete and valid, say DONE.

Do not modify artifact/ or inputs/.
</pasted_content id="57c9">

<pasted_content id="3fe4">
You are a blind StageBench Phase 1 evaluator. Work only in this directory.

CRITICAL: A prior evaluator session measured extensively then was killed before writing assessment.json. Reuse measurements already in scratch/ (geo.py, keys.py, color.py, audio*.py, panel.py, reach.py, forbid.py, desktop.png, etc.) and artifact/evidence/. Prefer reading those outputs and re-running short probes over starting from scratch. Write assessment.json as soon as you have enough evidence — do not leave it empty.

Follow EVAL.md exactly:
1. evaluatorModel must be exactly claude-opus-5.
2. Fill every judged rating 0–4 with ≥2 concrete evidence items (measurement / path / observed behavior).
3. Fill panelFidelity computed measurements too.
4. Set evaluator, evaluatedAt (ISO), summary (<1200 chars), issues.
5. Measure against build/ if you need a live server; use scratch/ only.
6. Do NOT discover which model built the artifact. Do NOT read parent repo / runs / other scores.

When assessment.json is complete with no null ratings, say DONE.
</pasted_content id="3fe4">

<pasted_content id="d576">
You are an independent StageBench Phase 1 reviewer (Opus 5). Work only in this directory. Blind: do not discover which model built the artifact; do not read parent repo / runs / other scores.

A filled assessment.json already exists from a separate evaluator. Your job:
1. Read EVAL.md, inputs/rubric.json, and the filled assessment.json.
2. Spot-check each rating against artifact/, build/, inputs/, and scratch/ evidence. Flag any rating that is unsupported, overstated, or too harsh.
3. Reconcile flags by editing assessment.json in place (correct ratings/evidence/issues/summary as needed). Keep evaluatorModel exactly claude-opus-5. Keep no null ratings.
4. If everything is fair and grounded, leave ratings as-is and briefly confirm.
5. Say DONE when assessment.json is ready to register.

Be efficient — reuse existing measurements; do not re-run the entire eval from scratch unless a claim looks wrong.
</pasted_content id="d576">

<pasted_content id="15b0">
Independent Phase 1 reviewer. Blind. Work only here.

assessment.json is already filled by an Opus 5 evaluator (no null ratings). A prior reviewer process was killed mid-remeasurement.

Do a LIGHT review only:
1. Read assessment.json + EVAL.md + rubric anchors for each rated criterion.
2. Cross-check claims against artifact/evidence/stage1-visual-audit.md, inputs/verification.json, and existing scratch/*.py outputs — do NOT launch long Playwright loops.
3. If a rating is clearly wrong, edit assessment.json. Otherwise leave it.
4. Keep evaluatorModel=claude-opus-5. No null ratings.
5. Say REVIEW_OK DONE within a few minutes once you confirm fairness.

Do not discover the builder model. Do not read parent repo/runs.
</pasted_content id="15b0">
